runtimeMapping.modes: Default 0, S1 takeoff/flight/landing 1/2/3 and S2 takeoff/flight/landing 4/5/6; expanded range persists through transitions. Source mode hooks redirect ordinary attacks to each flight loop.
runtimeMapping.flight: Native ExecuteBuff event 2 is bounded as transition start; event 3 as clip completion. Both source clips last 1s, height tween .833299994468689s, with height from the selected rank. Fly-core stays through landing; mode0 clears it. Ground blockers release while aerial blocking remains enabled.
runtimeMapping.attacks: Single-target current-ATK physical tracked projectiles at 10 tiles/s with 10s lifetime. First attack event 0; S2 adds shots at .2/.567 clip seconds, reselecting legal targets for each release and cancelling unfired events on control, removal or mode change. Clip clock caps at native maxAnimScale 1.
runtimeMapping.s2: Original ON_APPLYING_MODIFIER IsDamage/mode0/TriggerAutoSkill/checkBeforeTrigger precedes PhysicalAndMagical Evade. Ready SP alone never starts S2. TRUE damage may trigger flight but is not evaded; HPLOSS bypasses the damage modifier path.
runtimeMapping.talent: Selected promotion/potential stack_time drives one-second native stack ticks. Readiness lasts until one uncancelled dodgeable Physical/Arts modifier consumes it; accepted damage resets an unfinished timer, even if a shield absorbs all HP damage. S2 cancellation preserves ready talent.

verificationLimits: Original controller methods and numeric ExecuteBuff phase enum are not executable here. The transition start/completion mapping and fixed-step schedule are explicitly bounded; native game frame parity is not claimed.
ON_APPLYING_MODIFIER/ON_TAKE_DAMAGE map to mutable hit and accepted-damage hooks. Ordering against arbitrary unimplemented external damage-cancellation buffs is unverified.

Native target reselection, attack speed scaling and current-ATK projectile impacts are simulated; exact game-frame projectile interception, target acquisition ties and damage rounding remain unverified.
Native particle meshes, sound, hit effects and the talent-ready particle are retained as source references but not rendered by the web effect engine.
Modules, multiplayer/bond effects, environmental event modifiers, and cross-operator mechanics outside already reviewed regular-stage kits are not enabled.
